name: GaN Stillinger-Weber (Bere-Serra 2006)
validity_notes: Stillinger-Weber GaN parameterised specifically for dislocation cores in wurtzite GaN (the preferred choice for line/screw/threading-dislocation studies). Pairwise-derived 3-body terms. No long-range Coulomb. Less general than the Tersoff for bulk thermomechanics.
source_note: Copied verbatim from the local LAMMPS 15Jun2023 distribution (Potentials/GaN.sw).
